## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与结果

Describe the trigger, change and user-visible result.

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run, their results, and any skipped checks. UI changes should include fictional-data screenshots.

## Deployment impact / 部署影响

State any migrations, configuration changes or compatibility effects. Write "None" when there are none.

- [ ] No credentials, private tracking links or real personal data are included.
- [ ] Relevant installation/security documentation was updated.
